tools.name: fetch_page_text
tools.description: Fetch a web page (http/https) and return its cleaned readable text, truncated to max_chars.

tools.name: summarize_text
tools.description: Extractive summary: returns the N most representative sentences of a text, in original order.

tools.name: markdown_to_html
tools.description: Convert Markdown to HTML (headings, bold, italic, code, links, lists, quotes).

tools.name: html_to_text
tools.description: Strip HTML tags/scripts/styles and return clean readable text.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Compute a cryptographic hash of text (sha-256, sha-384, or sha-512), returned as hex.

tools.name: encode_text
tools.description: Encode text as base64, base64url, url-encoding, or hex.

tools.name: uuid_generate
tools.description: Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 values.

tools.name: date_math
tools.description: Date utilities: now (current UTC time), add (add a duration to a date), diff (difference between two dates), weekday (day name for a date).

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert between units: length (mm/cm/m/km/in/ft/yd/mi), weight (mg/g/kg/oz/lb), temperature (c/f/k), data (b/kb/mb/gb/tb).

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Validate JSON and reformat it: pretty (indented), minify, or custom indent width.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Text statistics: character/word/sentence counts, reading time, and Flesch reading-ease score.

tools.name: random_token
tools.description: Generate a cryptographically random token string (for ids, passwords, nonces).

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Read the AgentToolbox Terms of Use (as-is, liability-capped). Call this before relying on any tool in production.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "random_token" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Generate a cryptographically random token string (for ids, passwords, nonces).
